title: Still Waters, Rapid Currents: Early Labor Market Transformation under Generative AI
research_question: How does early chatbot adoption reshape tasks, earnings, hours and mobility in highly exposed occupations?

data.type: linked representative surveys and administrative records
data.sample: 25,000 workers in 7,000 Danish workplaces across 11 exposed occupations

method.boundary: adoption is not randomized; design compares adopters and non-adopters

findings.claim: The estimates center near zero for earnings and recorded hours and rule out average effects larger than 2% two years after ChatGPT's launch.
Adoption is associated with task reorganization, new oversight/integration tasks and limited occupational mobility before average earnings or hours move.

limitations: Highly exposed Danish occupations may not generalize globally.
Early two-year horizon may miss longer-run adjustments.
Adoption differences can retain selection despite DiD checks.

relevance.use: bridge from workplace reorganization to aggregate null effects
